name: Permis de Sejour (Family Sponsor)

requirements.blocker_text: No distinct 'regroupement familial' legal category was found for Haiti -- a joining family member uses the SAME general permis de sejour process as any other foreign resident (see ht_work_permit.json), with a family member resident in Haiti providing the support/repatriation guarantee letter that the DIE page allows from either an employer OR a sponsor. The same supporting documents apply: passport photocopy, medical certificate under 30 days old, two photos, a French-translated birth certificate, a criminal record, and a Haitian bank attestation of at least 7,500 gourdes (~$200), plus a 5,000-gourde application fee. Proof of the family relationship itself is a reasonable additional inference, not explicitly listed on the DIE page as a separate document category.
requirements.fix_path: Have the resident family member issue a sponsor guarantee letter and file the general permis de sejour application with proof of the family relationship.

evidence_required.document: Criminal record from country of origin

outcome.duration_length: not specified by the source; permis de sejour, presumed renewable

sources.title: Direction de l'Immigration et de l'Emigration (official government portal) -- general permis de sejour requirements, the page's own 'employer/sponsor' language
